briefdescription.para: LDM Phase 1-5 contract tests for ethics_ai module.

detaileddescription.para:
Test IDs: EAL-01..EAL-08
Coverage: DiscourseMode, equal-weight contract, ABSTAIN failsafe, MetaVerdict convergence, cross-cultural flag, mirror-school audit, Legal-DB flag.
All tests use mock/deterministic fixtures only — no file I/O, no real LLM. The stub LLM path in DiscourseOrchestrator is exercised directly.
